title: Dark Volume
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 008, Dark Volume, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.
hint: Drag the control, use arrow keys, Home or End.
css:
.d-drams-008{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:100%;height:320px;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box;background:#fff;color:#515151;font:400 12px/1.3 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;isolation:isolate;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .d-drams-008 *{box-sizing:border-box;font-family:inherit;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .d-drams-008 button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer} .d-drams-008 .control{position:relative;outline:none;touch-action:none;user-select:none} .d-drams-008 .control:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fa651f66;outline-offset:10px;border-radius:50%} .d-drams-008 .sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)} .d-drams-008 .disc{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;inset:0;will-change:transform} .d-drams-008 .white-disc{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f8f8f8,#e6e6e6);box-shadow:inset 1px 2px 3px #fff,inset -1px -2px 3px #d9d9d9,9px 12px 15px #00000026,2px 3px 3px #0000001a} .d-drams-008 .orange-dot{position:absolute;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fb641f} .d-drams-008 .mark{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;font-size:13px;line-height:1;color:#555;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)} .d-drams-008 .sphere{border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 31% 23%,#fff 0%,#f5f5f5 17%,#dfdfdf 47%,#a4a4a4 93%);box-shadow:inset 1px 2px 3px #fff7,0 9px 12px #00000016} .d-drams-008 .sphere:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:45%;top:45%;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff651f} .d-drams-008 button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fa651f66;outline-offset:5px}
.d-drams-008 .dark-shell{position:relative;width:148px;height:148px;background:#f6f6f6;border-radius:50%}.d-drams-008 .dots i{position:absolute;width:3px;height:3px;background:#141414;border-radius:50%}.d-drams-008 .dark-shell:before,.d-drams-008 .dark-shell:after{content:'';position:absolute;width:13px;height:1px;background:#111;bottom:25px;left:18px;transform:rotate(-45deg)}.d-drams-008 .dark-shell:after{left:auto;right:18px;transform:rotate(45deg)}.d-drams-008 .control{position:absolute;left:22px;top:22px;width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#5c5c5c,#090909 82%);border:2px solid #444;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #fff7,3px 6px 10px #0003}.d-drams-008 .disc{inset:19px;border:1px solid #292929;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#424242,#171717);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px #ffffff12,0 2px 4px #0007}.d-drams-008 .disc i{position:absolute;left:calc(50% - 2px);top:4px;width:4px;height:23px;border-radius:3px;background:#c25622}
prompt: Recreate the Dark Volume composition from https://drams.framer.website/drams/008 as standalone HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a native 300 by 320 white stage. Preserve its proportions, gentle physical materials, interaction states and keyboard access. Use locally bundled Inter for labels and tabular numerical values. Drag the control, use arrow keys, Home or End.
